title: Semiya Payasam
description: A silky South Indian vermicelli pudding simmered in milk with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
steps: Heat the ghee in a pan and fry the cashews and raisins until golden; remove and keep aside.
In the same ghee, lightly sauté the vermicelli for 1 to 2 minutes if it is not already roasted.
Add the milk and simmer on medium-low, stirring occasionally, until the vermicelli is soft, about 10 minutes.
Add the sugar and cardamom and cook 5 minutes until the payasam thickens slightly.
Stir in the fried cashews and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled; it thickens on standing, so loosen with a little milk if needed.
